---
title: Shortcode only in math
format:
  html: default
  latex: default
five: 5
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['5 \+ 5']
        - ['b58fc729|7B7B3C|\{\{&lt;']
    latex:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['5 \+ 5']
        - ['b58fc729|7B7B3C|\{\{<']
---

The shortcodes below are the only ones in this document, so nothing outside
math tells Quarto that the document contains shortcodes.

Inline: $5 + {{< meta five >}}$

Display: $$5 + {{< meta five >}}$$
